column3: Close to the Hebrew; the title אֲדֹנָי (“Lord,” Adonai) is printed “LORD.”
Close to the Hebrew; עַד־ דַּכָּא (“to dust”) is rendered “to destruction.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you flood them; they are sleep” is rendered “You carry them away like a flood; They are like a sleep.”
Close to the Hebrew; יְמוֹלֵל (“fades”) is rendered “is cut down.”
Close to the Hebrew; פָּנוּ (“decline”) is rendered “have passed away.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְרָהְבָּם (“their pride”) is rendered “their boast,” “toil and trouble” “labor and sorrow,” and “it passes quickly” “it is soon cut off.”
Close to the Hebrew; “that we may bring a heart of wisdom” is rendered “That we may gain a heart of wisdom.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the morning” is rendered “early,” and “covenant loyalty” “mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; וַהֲדָרְךָ (“your majesty”) is rendered “Your glory.”
Close to the Hebrew; נֹעַם (“the favor, pleasantness”) is rendered “the beauty.”
